title: AWARE 2.0 Phase 5 R6.2 — security audit follow-up fixes (operator-actionable findings)
deliverable: Close all 4 operator-actionable findings surfaced by the R6.1 end-to-end security scan: 2 Dockerfile USER misconfigs (prod), 1 Dockerfile USER allowlist (training, documented), 6 bandit findings in training/run.py (1 B110, 1 B108, 4× B615), 1 npm-audit moderate (uuid < 11.1.1).
operator_action: ./scripts/security-scan.sh   # all 4 checks now PASS with --strict exit 0
what_shipped: package.json (modified, 1 line) — uuid ^9.0.0 → ^11.1.1 (the legacy-11 dist-tag with the buffer-bounds-check fix from advisory GHSA-w5hq); npm install deduped to a single uuid@11.1.1 (matches modal's transitive)

training/run.py (modified, +6 lines) — added 'import tempfile' (L66); added '# nosec B110' to the L111 except: pass (documented last-resort fallback); replaced hardcoded '/tmp/azr-sandbox' with tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='azr-sandbox-') (L305, fixes B108); added hf_revision = os.environ.get('AWARE_HF_REVISION', 'main') (L291, L572) and threaded revision=hf_revision through all 4 from_pretrained call sites (L292, L295, L573, L579, fixes B615)

Dockerfile (modified, +9 lines) — added 'RUN addgroup -S aware && adduser -S aware -G aware' (L10), 'USER aware' (L39), with explanatory comment about avoiding root in production. Matches the existing pattern in Dockerfile.gateway and Dockerfile.coordinator (which already had it).

Dockerfile.ui (modified, +18/-7 lines) — switched base FROM 'nginx:alpine' (root) TO 'nginxinc/nginx-unprivileged:alpine' (UID 101); added explicit 'USER nginx' (L38) even though the unprivileged image defaults to non-root, because trivy still flags the Dockerfile unless the directive is present; 'EXPOSE 80' → 'EXPOSE 8080' (L41) to match the unprivileged-image's default listen port
docker-compose.yml (modified, 1 line) — port mapping '3001:80' → '3001:8080' with explanatory comment about the v1.0.0 → v2.0.0 unprivileged-nginx port change

.trivyignore (new, 27 lines) — allowlist DS-0002 for Dockerfile.training with a 22-line documented rationale: the training image runs as root inside an ephemeral Modal GPU pod (network namespaced, single job, 5h timeout); changing to non-root would require creating a user, chown'ing /opt/aware and /root/aware-data, validating GPU device access for an unprivileged user, and re-testing on Modal. The risk-vs-effort tradeoff is documented as acceptable for an ephemeral job runner; the gateway + coordinator images (which DO run as non-root `aware`) are the long-running surfaces and already follow the convention. 'Re-evaluate if Modal changes their pod security model.'

scripts/security-scan.sh (modified, +5 lines) — added --ignorefile .trivyignore flag to the 'trivy config' invocations, with an explanatory comment that trivy auto-picks up the file from the cwd (repo root).
<internal-doc> (modified) — R6.2 closure section appended to the existing R6.1 verification block

issues_fixed_in_this_slice.cve: GHSA-w5hq-m6gj-8cwm (uuid < 11.0.0: insecure non-cryptographic random IDs in some APIs; CVSS 5.3)
issues_fixed_in_this_slice.finding: uuid@9.0.1 (direct dep) — buffer-bounds-check issue in legacy versions
issues_fixed_in_this_slice.fix: Bump direct dep to ^11.1.1 (the 'legacy-11' dist-tag with the patch). No API risk: uuid 9→11 is stable for our usage (v4 random IDs for trace IDs and request IDs). Modal's transitive uuid was already at 11.1.1, so no peer-dep churn.

# nosec B110 with comment 'intentional last-resort fallback'. Rationale: the surrounding try block catches every exception type in a process where even sys.stderr is sometimes gone (long-lived GPU process on Modal). This is a deliberate 'absolute last resort' fallback, not a sloppy 'I don't care'.
tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='azr-sandbox-'). Atomic, mode 0700, unique per-process. Eliminated the TOCTOU race that B108 was warning about.

Added revision=hf_revision to all 4 sites. hf_revision = os.environ.get('AWARE_HF_REVISION', 'main'). Default is 'main' (HF's recommended practice for tracking upstream fixes); operators can pin to a SHA in production for full reproducibility. Documented trade-off in code comment at L285-291.
Added RUN addgroup -S aware && adduser -S aware -G aware (L10) and USER aware (L39). Matches the existing pattern in Dockerfile.gateway/Dockerfile.coordinator (which already passed trivy).

Two-part fix: (1) base image nginx:alpine → nginxinc/nginx-unprivileged:alpine (UID 101 by default), (2) explicit USER nginx directive at L38 (trivy requires the directive to be present in the Dockerfile, even if the base image's default is non-root). Cascading port changes: EXPOSE 80 → 8080, nginx.conf listen 80 → 8080, docker-compose.yml 3001:80 → 3001:8080. The unprivileged image is designed for exactly this pattern.

Allowlisted via .trivyignore (NOT fixed). Rationale: ephemeral Modal GPU pod, network-namespaced, 5h timeout, single job, only the per-job 'aware-training-data' Volume is mounted. Changing to non-root requires re-validating GPU device access for unprivileged user + chown of /opt/aware and /root/aware-data + re-testing on Modal. Documented in the .trivyignore file with a 're-evaluate if Modal changes their pod security model' note. The v1.0.0 baseline comment in the original Dockerfile already acknowledged this design choice.
